description: Provides an advanced exploration of cutting-edge Generative AI models including VAEs, GANs, diffusion models, Generative Pre-trained Transformers, and multimodal synthesis.
learning_objectives: Master mathematical foundations of deep generative models: VAEs, GANs, and Diffusion models.
Design and evaluate image generation (Diffusion, StyleGAN) and text-to-image architectures.
Understand Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT) architecture, RLHF, and prompt engineering.
Address ethical considerations, deepfake detection, explainability, and bias in Generative AI.
outline: Generative AI Foundations: Overview of generative vs discriminative modeling, energy-based models, normalizing flows.
Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs): DCGAN, WGAN-GP, StyleGAN, conditional GANs, image-to-image translation (Pix2Pix, CycleGAN).
Advanced Variational Autoencoders: Hierarchical VAEs, Semi-supervised VAEs, Vector Quantized VAEs (VQ-VAE).
Diffusion & Score-Based Models: DDPM, DDIM, classifier-free guidance, latent diffusion models (Stable Diffusion).
Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPT): Transformer decoders, autoregressive text generation, fine-tuning with LoRA/PEFT, RLHF.
Multimodal Generative Systems: CLIP, text-to-image synthesis, prompt engineering, multimodal architectures.
Ethics & Explainability: Bias mitigation, deepfake detection, watermarking, mechanistic interpretability.
